description: Moves the USDC in each deal address to the owner's payout wallet (ROOMS_PAYOUT_TO in this server's config, or else this agent's own wallet). The destination can't be set from chat, so no message can redirect it. This agent's wallet (ROOMS_WALLET_KEY) pays the gas, so it needs a little ETH. Privacy: the sweep shows on-chain that those deal addresses are linked to the destination, so sweep rarely and preferably to a wallet that isn't the one in your card.
name: payouts_sweep
title: Move money out of my private deal addresses (seller)
